message.content:
This document is a technical README for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer and prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Architecture & Memory**
- Three-tier expert storage: VRAM cache → pinned RAM → NVMe SSD, with experts streamed on demand.
- Supports NVIDIA (compute 7.0+, up to 16 GPUs), AMD (experimental: gfx1100/1201/1151), and
